data.name: Glow- A Neon Street Art Workshop
data.headline: Learn street art techniques under ultraviolet light — your colors literally pop off the wall.
data.description:
Studio W.I.P. invites you to unleash your creativity at our Glow Workshop — a blacklight-powered art experience like no other. Guided by our street art instructors, you’ll work with vibrant neon paints that come alive in the dark, transforming your canvas into a glowing masterpiece.

Whether you’re looking for a fun night out, a unique date idea, or a creative way to connect with friends, this workshop promises an unforgettable, high-energy atmosphere.

Create your own neon masterpiece on canvas (11” x 14”). 

Come ready to paint, play, and glow!
data.highlights:
Step into the dark and let your creativity shine. Our Neon Glow Workshop is an electrifying black light experience where street art meets ultraviolet color. Guests learn to paint, tag, and design using glowing pigments that come alive under UV light — turning every canvas into a radiant masterpiece.

💡 What to Expect:

Hands-on black light spray paint + stencil art

Luminous gear and creative freestyle zones

Live DJ and immersive lighting

Glow photo ops to capture your creation

It’s more than a workshop — it’s a full-spectrum vibe.
The darker it gets, the brighter you shine.

data.cancellation_notes:
If you notify the studio more than 48 hours from your original reservation date, a full refund will be issued upon request.
If you notify the studio 48 hours or less from your original reservation date a studio credit will be issued for your use towards a future class.
If you notify the studio 2 hours or less before the class starts, no refund or credit will be issued.
A re-booking fee applies.
Private Workshops follow the cancellation policy terms outlined in the Private Event Agreement(Invoice) signed by the host.
All credits must be utilized within 6 months of the original booking date. 
For parties of 6 or more, a 25% cancellation fee is applied.
Bad Weather: Workshops and tours will cancel if a weather emergency is declared, otherwise our cancellation policy is as stated above. Studio credit will be issued to all registered guests in the rare case of a class cancellation due to poor weather conditions. Please see our website for updates in case of questionable weather.
Late Arrivals: We will do our best to catch you up.  It may be difficult to finish your painting, and we cannot extend the paint time for the workshop. We do not refund or credit late arrivals. Please arrive no later than 10 minutes before the scheduled class or tour time.
data.booking_notes: We are excited to GLOW with you in the studio. Please keep in mind that parking is a premium in our area. We urge guests to use public transit or taxis.
data.check_in_details: Check in with our artist at the front deck.
data.special_requirements: All children under 18 must be accompanied by an adult.
data.restrictions: Our workshop is not suggested for anyone who is visually impaired.
